title: Chained assignments learned with the resolution rule supplied
summary: Assignments are stored as rows. The learner is supplied with the rule that a variable denotes the constant reached by following its assignments back, so it only learns an output translation.
core_idea: Supply the learner with the resolution rule for assignment chains, so binding is learned from 40 items.

state.name: As
state.meaning: Assignment rows (left variable, right symbol), C = 64.

state.name: lh
state.meaning: Left variable waiting for its right symbol.

state.name: Res2
state.meaning: Supplied resolution rule: the constant reached by following assignments back from a variable, evaluated on the prefix.

update.latex: lh=\varnothing \Rightarrow lh \leftarrow x_t;\;\text{else } As_{na} \leftarrow (lh, x_t),\; na \leftarrow na+1
update.plain: assignments and pairs are stored as rows, appended in order
update.name: row store

readout.plain: the supplied hypothesis resolves the probe variable; Tr maps the constant; other tasks read rows

learning.description: Given Res2, Tr is the majority map over the m items; other routings by training accuracy.
learning.few_shot_argument: One supplied rule, an 8-entry map: m = 40 items with 2 probes each cover all 8 constants on every seed.

complexity.constants_notes: Row writes O(1), row reads scan C rows; 2C + 3 words.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: The supplied rule leaves an 8-entry map.

prediction.statement: From m = 40 binding items with chains of 2 hops, per-query accuracy is at least 0.99 on three seeds.

capabilities.prediction: Learned at hops 2 from m = 40; exact at hops 1, 4, 8 with C = 64.
Exact at the listed sizes with C = 64.
The limit is a storage count: C slots of two words cannot hold more than C pairs, so at C = 64 an instance with 65 or more distinct pairs loses one of them.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: This card does not compare its mechanism with others.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: No difference from earlier work is claimed.

falsifiers: 40 items at hops 2 after which accuracy is below 0.99 on a seed.
A chain of 8 hops resolved wrongly by the hand-set rows.

toy_example.description: The supplied rule on one item with two chains of two hops.
